title: SCRUM-81: PwD - Explore Product Tabs - Accessibility Test Plan
overview: Accessibility test plan for product tabs: ARIA roles tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-selected on active tab, arrow key navigation, Enter/Space activation, focus moves to panel, heading hierarchy in panels, contrast ≥4.5:1, 200% zoom, screen reader announces tab changes.

testCases.title: Each tab has role=tab
steps: Verify role=tab on Features, Technical, Buying Guide, Reviews, Raise a Query

testCases.title: Tabs navigable with arrow keys
steps: Press ArrowRight to move to next tab

testCases.title: Enter/Space activates focused tab
steps: Focus a tab via arrow keys

testCases.title: Only one tab panel visible at a time
steps: Verify only one panel visible at a time

testCases.title: Focus moves to active panel on tab selection
steps: Verify focus moves to panel content or stays on tab

testCases.title: Panel content has logical heading hierarchy
steps: Verify headings in panel follow hierarchy

testCases.title: Tab switching does not reload page
expectedResults: No page reload on tab switch

testCases.title: Active tab visually highlighted
steps: Verify distinction not by color alone

testCases.title: Tab text contrast meets 4.5:1
steps: Verify ≥4.5:1 for active and inactive tabs

testCases.title: Tab focus indicators visible with ≥3:1 contrast
No keyboard traps in tab navigation
steps: Tab through all tabs and panel content
Verify focus moves past tabs to rest of page

testCases.title: Screen reader announces tab changes
steps: Use screen reader to navigate tabs
Verify tab name and selected state announced
Verify panel content announced on switch

testCases.title: Reviews tab shows count in header
steps: Verify review count visible in tab header
